5 · G. F. Morris (T.V.H.) · 33 12 · 30 · F. G. White · 35 39

Belgrave again came out best in the above match, Len Marchant proving how much he has improved by again beating George Morris, T.V.H., the indoor half-mile champion, by inches, in 2mins. 4/5 secs., Frank Webb running as well as ever to finished 3rd.
He found the pace in the Mile a bit too fast for him, but finished a very creditable fourth, and G. Morris just held off Les Cohen to win a good race.
Day, of Thames Valley, won the 440 Yards with G.
